text:
Alex (ProdMkt): Heads-up — embargo lift for the 'Latency vs Cost' benchmark is set for Tue Apr 5 09:00 PT. Need final assets, CEO quote, and channel plan by EOD tomorrow.
Priya (PR): Noted. Can we move to 08:30 PT to accommodate APAC press desks?
Alex (ProdMkt): 08:30 PT works if ops can confirm no infra throttles at that time.
Liam (Eng): We're clear on capacity, but confirm which metric we are calling out (median vs p99).
Maya (Social): Draft social posts below. Will need final link and quote.
Maya (Social): Tweet draft:
```
Redwood Inference sets a new bar: 40% lower median latency at scale vs common baselines. Full benchmark + methodology → <shortlink>
```
Priya (PR): Suggest change 'median' -> 'median end-to-end' or add parenthetical to avoid confusion. Also ask for one-line summary for reporters.
Ben (Comms): @Sam we need a 1-2 sentence quote for the press release. Can you approve this one?:
"We built Redwood to make inference predictable and efficient at any scale — this benchmark underscores that focus."
Sam (CEO): I can shorten it: "This benchmark proves predictable, high-performance inference is achievable at scale." Fine to use.
Liam (Eng): Confirming tests measured median token latency across 10k samples on our Dedicated config. p99 is within 1.2x, but headline uses median.
Priya (PR): OK thanks — we'll include a methodology blurb and link to the repo. Ben, prepare embargo PR wire and target reporters list.
Ben (Comms): Will do. Draft PR wire ready by tomorrow noon. Need final quote and link.
Alex (ProdMkt): I'll finalize the blog draft and attach screenshots + perf graphs. Maya, can you prepare 3 social image tiles (benchmark chart, product hero, CEO headshot) by EOD?
Maya (Social): Yup — will push to the assets folder and ping when ready. :white_check_mark:
Alex (ProdMkt): Ops, can you run a quick privacy/redaction check on logs we plan to publish (no customer data etc)?
OpsBot: audit-run — log-scan scheduled, expected complete in 35m. No active incidents.
Liam (Eng): Also confirm model versions we tested: rwd-infer-v2.1 and open-baseline-1.0. I'll drop the exact commit SHAs in the doc.
Priya (PR): When we lift embargo, distribution plan: press wire at T0, company blog post on blog.redwood.ai + gated technical appendix, social posts at T+5m across X/LinkedIn, and email to early adopters at T+20m. Agree?
Ben (Comms): Add regional timings: stagger APAC at T-2h local for coverage. I'll schedule via the CMS.
Alex (ProdMkt): Great. @Sam confirm quote posted here satisfies legal? We need legal sign-off too.
Sam (CEO): Approved. Legal has reviewed the benchmark methodology earlier; loop them into the PR wire for final stamp.
Ben (Comms): Noted — adding Legal now.
Priya (PR): One more ask: if press calls come in, prefer Alex + Liam on technical, Sam for exec calls. Ben will triage.
Maya (Social): Final social captions will include: shortlink, CEO quote snippet, 2 hashtags (#RedwoodInference #LLMserving).
Alex (ProdMkt): Awesome. I'll send an internal heads-up email after assets are uploaded. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
Ben (Comms): Scheduling note: deploy-bot will queue the blog publish for Apr 5 08:25 PT, manual check at T-5m.
deploy-bot: scheduled publish job created for 2026-04-05T08:25:00-07:00.
Alex (ProdMkt): Closing thread — please @mention on updates.
Priya (PR): Will post final asset list here once uploaded.
Maya (Social): Uploaded images to //assets/benchmark_apr5/ and notified design.
Liam (Eng): Pushed commit SHAs and methodology link to the draft appendix.
OpsBot: audit-run complete — no sensitive data detected.
Ben (Comms): PR wire queued, awaiting final blog URL and CEO quote (both confirmed).
Alex (ProdMkt): Thanks all, moving to execution. :tada:
